descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join the eFraud team and contribute to the development and evolution of our fraud detection platform. As part of our team, you will play an essential role in the innovation and creation process of Societe Generale software solutions that can reshape the digital world of tomorrow.
 💻 What you will do: 
Carry out Big Data developments to meet eFraud business and technical needs, perform end-to-end testing by defining test scenarios and documenting defects, and support deployments to production.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements, design solutions, and implement features that meet business needs.
Design, develop and maintain data pipelines for extracting, transforming and loading data from different sources.
Develop and maintain the data infrastructure (database, data warehouses, data lake) and data visualization tools.
Help anticipate, investigate, and prevent production incidents affecting fraud detection microservices hosted on the Big Data platform (investigation, follow-up, and communication with all stakeholders involved).
Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices.
Troubleshoot and debug issues, and implement fixes to ensure the stability, performance, and security of applications.
Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies and continuously improve technical skills and knowledge.
Build a strategy to reduce technical debt, improve security, and ensure the decommissioning of unused resources.
Contribute to maintaining up-to-date documentation and ensuring compliance with data governance and data usage standards.
Implement and monitor data quality controls, reconciliation mechanisms, and data observability processes.
Ensure data lineage, traceability, and compliance with Group data governance standards.
Contribute to the evolution of the data platform architecture, evaluating new technologies and best practices in Data Engineering, Cloud, AI, and Analytics.
Explore opportunities to leverage AI and GenAI capabilities to improve fraud detection processes, data analysis, and engineering productivity.
 💡 REQUIRED PROFILE 
Minimum 4 years of experience as a data engineer (development activities, PROD follow-up)
Mandatory technical skills: Scala, Spark, Hadoop/Cloudera ecosystem, SQL, Elasticsearch, Git, CI/CD, Jira
Nice to have: HDFS, HBase, Control-M, Yarn, Kafka, Snowflake, Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
Language: English – Advanced, French knowledge would be considered a plus
Familiarity with database systems (SQL & NoSQL) such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, HBase
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
Demonstrates ownership, autonomy, and a continuous improvement mindset 
Ability to challenge existing solutions and propose innovative approaches
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
 WHY JOIN US: 
 Here, you will find a flexible workplace and culture, autonomy, constant learning opportunities, dynamism, and talented people, making this experience a real career accelerator. You will also discover all the diversity of our businesses, in a sector that is constantly evolving and innovating.
 If you feel like ambitiously pursuing your goals, then you have come to the right place.
 Plus, you will enjoy all our benefits: 
competitive compensation & remuneration, including annual performance bonus;
preventive healthcare plan, and group health & life insurance;
wide range of flexible benefits within a monthly budget;
office perks, wellbeing and mental health programs;
various social benefits and bonuses for personal or family events;
additional paid and unpaid time off, including Sabbatical leave;
learning and growth opportunities based on individual development and career plans;
unlimited access to various eLearning resources.
 🌈 We are an equal opportunities employer and we are proud to make diversity a strength for our company. Société General is committed to recognizing and promoting all talents, regardless of their beliefs, age, disability, parental status, ethnic origin, nationality, sexual or gender identity, sexual orientation, membership of a political, religious, trade union or minority organization, or any other characteristic that could be subject to discrimination.
